title: Bundle size check fails on ESM output
body: check-bundle-size.js globs dist/assets/*.js and misses every .mjs chunk emitted by the ESM build, so the gate passes on an oversized bundle.

title: Prisma drift check exits 0 when the schema is dirty
body: scripts/check-prisma-drift.sh swallows the non-zero exit of prisma migrate diff because the pipeline ends in tee. The gate is green whatever the schema says.

title: Bundle size budget is not enforced for the ESM bundle
body: Older report of the same family of defect as the newer bundle work. A branch is already open against this one.

title: Required workflow steps are not covered by the parity test
body: The parity test asserts job names only, so a removed step in the deploy job goes unnoticed until a release fails.

title: Teacher dashboard renders nothing when a class is empty
body: A teacher with no enrolled students sees a blank panel with no explanation and no call to action.

title: Add a first-good-issue walkthrough to the onboarding docs
body: Reserved for the intern cohort: a guided walkthrough from clone to first merged change.

title: Migrate the API layer to a typed RPC boundary
body: Replace the hand-rolled fetch wrappers with a typed boundary shared by the frontend and the backend. Touches every route.

title: Split the monolithic seed script into per-domain seeders
body: backend/scripts/seed.ts is over a thousand lines and reseeds everything on every run.

title: Flaky unit test in teacher-dashboard.test.tsx
body: Fails roughly one run in six on CI, always on the same waitFor. Someone is already on it.

title: Dark mode toggle resets on navigation
body: The theme preference is held in component state rather than persisted, so every route change reverts to light.

title: chore(deps): bump the build toolchain to the current minor
body: Automated dependency bump. GitHub serves this from the issues endpoint even though it is a pull request.
